MS2137.source_note: The best-fit lens-model parameter table defines its reference coordinate as the center of the MS2137 BCG.

A2537.source: Stott et al. 2011, arXiv:1101.4652, Table 2 source row
A2537.source_note: The independent BCG surface-photometry table gives A2537 at 23:08:22.3, -02:11:32. This replaces the unusable Cerny et al. 2018 Table 10 caption, which prints the Abell 2163 coordinate.

MACS J0326.source_note: The best-fit lens-model parameter table defines all offsets relative to this BCG coordinate.

MACS J0417.source: Mahler et al. 2019, arXiv:1810.13439, best-fit parameter table
MACS J0417.source_note: Reference coordinate is 64.394552,-11.908871 deg; BCG1 is fixed at offset (0.0,+0.1) arcsec, positive north-west.

MACS J0949.source: Allingham et al. 2023, arXiv:2207.10520, best-fit parameter table
MACS J0949.source_note: The model center is defined as the cluster center/BCG position.

MACS J1427.source_note: The MACS J1427 caption repeats the MS2137 BCG coordinate, so the absolute BCG center cannot be verified from this source.
MACS J1427.profile_center: not recoverable from the published source table
